scripts.tunnel:up: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env --profile telegram-tunnel up -d cloudflared
scripts.tunnel:status: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env --profile telegram-tunnel ps cloudflared
scripts.tunnel:logs: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env --profile telegram-tunnel logs -f cloudflared
scripts.tunnel:down: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env --profile telegram-tunnel stop cloudflared && docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env --profile telegram-tunnel rm -f cloudflared
